gloss: unstoppable momentum; sweeping all before one

definitions.gloss: unstoppable momentum; sweeping all before one
definitions.explanation: Momentum so strong that nothing can stop it, like bamboo that splits all the way once the first joint is cut; said of a team, army or person winning one victory after another.

examples.japanese: {破竹|はちく}の{勢|いきお}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}ち{進|すす}む→勝ち進む：32576_kachisusumu⟧。
examples.english: To win round after round, unstoppable.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{破竹|はちく}の{勢|いきお}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{十連勝|じゅうれんしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The team swept to ten straight wins.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{破竹|はちく}の{勢|いきお}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{利用者|りようしゃ}→利用者：03189_riyousha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やし→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧、⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{業界一位|ぎょうかいいちい}になった。
examples.english: The new app gained users at an unstoppable pace and became number one in the industry within a year.

notes:
Almost always used adverbially as {破竹|はちく}の{勢|いきお}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ + verb (⟦{勝|か}ち{進|すす}む→勝ち進む：32576_kachisusumu⟧, ⟦{連勝|れんしょう}→連勝：06528_renshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, ⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧). From a classical Chinese image: once bamboo is split at the top, it splits all the way down.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飛|と}ぶ{鳥|とり}を{落|お}とす{勢|いきお}い→飛ぶ鳥を落とす勢い：34019_tobutoriwootosuikioi⟧: at the height of one's power — a state, not a run of wins
- ⟦{日|ひ}の{出|で}の{勢|いきお}い→日の出の勢い：34029_hinodenoikioi⟧: rising fast, like the morning sun
